title: add-prefetch-signal-exporter-and-econ-telemetry-bridge
author: Aisha Kaur
description:
Motivation: Observability gaps make it hard to reason about tenant-level prefetch/batching effectiveness, cache hit impacts and quantization hint usefulness when tuning unit economics. This change introduces a lightweight Prefetch Signal Exporter (CLI + sidecar-able server) and an Econ Telemetry Bridge adapter that standardizes a compact proto envelope for prefetch signals and quantization hints.

What this PR does: adds a CLI/service that samples runtime prefetch and cache metrics, computes per-tenant summary signatures, attaches a small set of quant-hint scores (quality vs cost tradeoff estimator), serializes into proto/prefetch.v1.PrefetchEnvelope and ships to the new econ telemetry bridge endpoint. The bridge adapts the envelope for Console ingestion and the unit-econ simulator. Exports are rate-limited and configurable per-tenant.

Key design choices:
- Use a compact proto to avoid large JSON payloads (proto v1 under proto/prefetch).
- Redact/rotate tenant identifiers by hashing and including only tenant_hash to avoid PII leakage.
- Default sampling cadence: 60s (configurable).
- Attach small quantization hint vector (3 floats: q_score_latency, q_score_cost, q_confidence) to help offline autotuners recommend quant profiles.
- Provide a CLI dry-run mode and an integration test that posts into a local test bridge.

Checklist:
- [x] Proto definitions and generated code
- [x] Exporter CLI + server implementation
- [x] Bridge adapter to Console ingest format + unit-econ adapter
- [x] Unit and integration tests (CI flaky test retried once)
- [x] README and runbook stub with safety/disable option
- [x] Configuration flags for sampling, redaction, retention limits

Migration notes and rollout: Start as opt-in flag on org-level config; telemetry team will enable for a small cohort (10 tenants) for 2 weeks before wider rollout. Backwards compatibility: bridge accepts older envelopes and will ignore unknown fields.

Privacy and compliance: No raw tenant IDs are emitted; tenant_hash is salted server-side. We audited the payload to avoid any model outputs. Retention defaults align with telemetry retention policy (30 days) and can be shortened.

Related: ENG-3412 (prefetch observability), ENG-3491 (quant-hint contract). See runbook link and milestone notes.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Please ensure the tenant_hash uses a per-deployment salt and document rotation procedure. Also request a benchmark: CPU/memory overhead at 60s sampling for 10k tenants.
Riley Chen: The proto looks good but the field names q_score_* are ambiguous. Suggest rename to q_latency_score, q_cost_score, q_confidence. Also add versioning field to envelope header.
Priya Patel: Tests look comprehensive; please add an integration test that validates the bridge output consumed by the unit-econ simulator (not just HTTP 200).
Security Bot (automated): flagged proto/prefetch for potential sensitive field tenant_id in older branch – confirm removal/consult compliance.
author_responses: Aisha Kaur: Updated tenant hashing to use the deployment salt (configurable via REDWOOD_PREFETCH_SALT) and added rotation section to runbook. Added a lightweight microbenchmark (scripts/bench/ sample_results.md) showing ~0.6% CPU at 60s for 10k tenants on staging; included numbers in PR description.
Aisha Kaur: Renamed q_score_* -> q_latency_score, q_cost_score, q_confidence and added envelope.version = 1. Documented proto versioning in proto/prefetch/README.md.

Aisha Kaur: Added integration test that posts a sample envelope and asserts the simulator received a mapped message (tests/integration/test_prefetch_export_end_to_end.go). CI job retries once for the e2e test to reduce flakes.
Aisha Kaur: Removed tenant_id from proto and replaced with tenant_hash in generated code; added note about older branches in the security response.
approvals: Priya Patel - APPROVED (after integration test added)
release_notes: Add Prefetch Signal Exporter and Econ Telemetry Bridge: ships sampled tenant-level prefetch, cache and quant-hint signals for cost optimization tooling. Opt-in rollout, tenant hashes only (no PII). CLI and service included with runbook and integration tests.
test_plan:
Local: ./cli/prefetch-exporter --dry-run --config ./configs/dev.yaml
Staging: enable feature flag for 10 tenants for 2 weeks, validate Console dashboard ingestion and unit-econ simulator outputs.
Production: enable via org-config with a gradual rollout and monitor exporter_cpu, exporter_error_rate, telemetry_bridge_latency metrics.
notes_for_ops: Default cadence is 60s; disable by setting REDWOOD_PREFETCH_EXPORTER_ENABLED=false. If bridge backlog exceeds threshold, bridge returns 429 and exporter will backoff with jitter. See runbook for escalation steps and rollback commands.
